alt: A Coco autonomous delivery robot lying upturned in a roadside hedge in Chicago after being thrown there by a cyclist frustrated by being brake-checked on the pavement
story: Coco autonomous delivery robots, deployed across Chicago pavements to modernise urban last-mile logistics, had already sent residents to hospitals and smashed through bus stops before a fixie rider filmed himself hurling one into a hedge on September 11, 2026, after it blocked and 'brake-checked' him.
why_funny: Coco's entire design premise is that autonomous robots can safely share city footpaths with humans — and the public verdict arrived in the form of one man's determined hedge-toss.
